See this game as a way to validate traders. There is a naunced difference between that and actually managing a hedge fund which manages an entire portfolio of assets. 
Would definitely like to see more innovation in that direction for hedge funds. But definitely sees this game will facilitate that
How does the tokenomics table work?
How do we go about figuring out some reasonable way to establishing an exchange rate
How would investors who put in money like himself be able to cash out

1. I like the general idea, many possibilities: trading validation, pay to play (which builds our reservoir and coin value), play to earn, and trade copying services (which can be fee earning for both trader & the Dao).
2. I am less thrilled about the idea of progression to a hedge fund. Possible, but it's a different ball game.
3. I also think there is a fine line between gamification and appearing scammy. So you need to thread carefully and maintain a pro outlook to be taken seriously by both traders and investors.
My main question is... what's in it for seed investors. I probably don't quite understand tokenomics, and how this pays out to the contributors.

Focus Group participants screening form

A couple of comments on the form:
1. Ideally do not ask for exact date of birth as it's sensitive personal data which we should not need. We can ask for survey participants to select age bands (e.g. 18-25; 26-35; 36-50; above 50). Generally avoid asking for personal data unlesa absolutely necessary, because it attracts data privacy obligations. 
2. Even if an individual is a professional fund/wealth manager or trader, you still would want to capture the individual's personal account trading habits. So it may not be entirely useful to filter out all investment professionals. Rather, focus the question on personal accounts. 
3. Might be a good opportunity to also ask about things like familiarity with/use of trading bots, copytrade APIs etc... whatever is planned within our DAO.

Project Goals:
In my view, this space would benefit from an aim to evolve with some structure, with tangible, practical, RL benefits. 
While predictions on an unlimited range of topics may be interesting and entertaining, it may not bring real benefits and may not attract and retain users, or build a community. 
Contrast that to a more targeted platform or space for predictions that are actionable and comparable - e.g. spaces where users make and wager predictions on major tradable markets like S&P, BTC, Gold, etc, over specific durations. 
This creates an ecosystem of actionable insights - consistently good predictors get higher scores, get a following and subscribers. Followers/subscribers can trade based on insights, and profit, and refer new followers to join the community.
Then from there you can expand into newer/niched areas where predictions are again actionable and profitable, hence creating a growth loop. 
All the while, there can be avenues for sharing and learning, as the sideshow. But there would be benefits to having main/core pillars which are actionable.

NFT Minting: Early access concerns (Response via WhatsApp)

Like limiting the NFTs to the first 50 governors will restrict gains/profits for latecomers, who may otherwise make great contributions to the ecosystem. Just need to be mindful of that. 
I guess there is an interplay between voting and economic rights, when it comes to the NFTs/coins issued. 
How can we make sure that voting is not concentrated in the hands of a few? But not too distributed at the same time.

Gamification and Governance: Explained clearly how TrueSight protocol is different from Binomo's.

- TrueSight DAO verifies acccuracy of a prediction through use of a third party orcale network (Pyth.Network)
- In Binomo's case, they determine the price of Crypto IDX


- In TrueSight DAO players are playing against other players. 
        - Our DAO (all possible players) will subsidize the game play by providing a seed  from our reservse to incentize game play if there are not enough active players to form a two sided market
        - Our DAO will take a small cut from the payout proceeds to replenish our reserves so as to ensure it does not get depleted through ongoing subsidies
- In Binomo players are betting against the house which controls the odds and payouts. 


- In essense from the game play perspective, Binomo functions more like a casino while TrueSight DAO functions more like a clearing house

On NFT design: two NFTs is confusing

On NFT design: associating shipment with NFT is confusing. shipment is a cost incurring activity, not a value generating one. The only value generation comes from purchase by a buyer = profit in the hands of the DAO (or the cocoa NFT owners, if the DAO has sold fractionalised ownership to them).
On NFT design: Most logical funding structure should be the same as export trade financing, but tokenized and syndicated.

On NFT design: For the cocoa NFT holders, they would be taking delivery risk - if the buyer does not get the cocoa for any reason, they lose the cocoa and their NFT value. 
Shipment insurance should be put in place.

narrative.text: Suhaimi Zainul contributed to Agroverse and Cypher Defense projects from March 2022 to August 2023, with contributions primarily in the Build Game Strategy category. He reviewed proposed strategies and suggested clear, specific improvements on four occasions, provided reference material links three times, and offered cautions against certain actions or areas to watch three times. Suhaimi contributed strategy extensions with reference materials twice, participated in one online poll vote, and delivered a full-scale strategy with rollout action plan to grow the DAO once. His work focused on strategic review, reference provision, and planning.
